<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" id="Definitions_LegoMachine" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/lego-machine">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_LegoMachine" name="Building a custom machine out of Lego bricks" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Begin" name="Start building the machine"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DevelopDesign" name="Develop basic design"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrderSets" name="Order Lego brick sets"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SortParts" name="Children sort parts into containers"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BuildMerge" name="Build subcomponent"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_BuildSubcomponent" name="Build subcomponent from container parts"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PartsCheck" name="Container empty?" default="Flow_PartsAvailable"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReorderParts" name="Reorder individual parts"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestSubcomponent" name="Test subcomponent individually"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TestResult" name="Test successful?" default="Flow_TestFailed"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssembleSubcomponent" name="Assemble subcomponent"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RedesignSubcomponent" name="Redesign and rebuild subcomponent"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Machine" name="Machine assembled"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToDesign" sourceRef="StartEvent_Begin" targetRef="Task_DevelopDesign"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DesignToOrder" sourceRef="Task_DevelopDesign" targetRef="Task_OrderSets"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderToSort" sourceRef="Task_OrderSets" targetRef="Task_SortParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SortToBuildMerge" sourceRef="Task_SortParts" targetRef="Gateway_BuildMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MergeToBuild" sourceRef="Gateway_BuildMerge" targetRef="Task_BuildSubcomponent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BuildToPartsCheck" sourceRef="Task_BuildSubcomponent" targetRef="Gateway_PartsCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ContainerEmpty" name="Container empty" sourceRef="Gateway_PartsCheck" targetRef="Task_ReorderParts">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${containerEmpty == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PartsAvailable" name="Parts available" sourceRef="Gateway_PartsCheck" targetRef="Task_TestSubcomponent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReorderToBuildMerge" sourceRef="Task_ReorderParts" targetRef="Gateway_BuildMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BuildToTest" sourceRef="Task_TestSubcomponent" targetRef="Gateway_TestResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TestPassed" name="Test successful" sourceRef="Gateway_TestResult" targetRef="Task_AssembleSubcomponent">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${testSuccessful == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TestFailed" name="Test not successful" sourceRef="Gateway_TestResult" targetRef="Task_RedesignSubcomponent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RedesignToBuildMerge" sourceRef="Task_RedesignSubcomponent" targetRef="Gateway_BuildMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AssembleToEnd" sourceRef="Task_AssembleSubcomponent" targetRef="EndEvent_Machine"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_LegoMachine" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/lego-machine">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_LegoMachine" name="Building a custom machine out of Lego bricks" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Responsibility">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Builder" name="Builder">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Begin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DevelopDesign</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_OrderSets</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_HandOverSets</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SubProcess_Subcomponent</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AssembleSubcomponent</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Machine</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Children" name="Group of children">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SortParts</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Begin" name="Start building the machine"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DevelopDesign" name="Develop basic design"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrderSets" name="Order Lego brick sets"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_HandOverSets" name="Hand over Lego sets to children"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_SortParts" name="Sort parts into containers"/>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_Subcomponent" name="Build, test and redesign each subcomponent">
      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics isSequential="true"/>
      <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Subcomponent" name="Start subcomponent build"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BuildMerge" name="Ready to build subcomponent"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PartsCheck" name="Container empty?" default="Flow_PartsAvailable"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_ReorderParts" name="Reorder individual parts"/>
      <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_BuildSubcomponent" name="Build subcomponent from container parts"/>
      <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_TestSubcomponent" name="Test subcomponent individually"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TestResult" name="Test successful?" default="Flow_TestFailed"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_RedesignSubcomponent" name="Redesign and rebuild subcomponent"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_SubcomponentPassed" name="Subcomponent passed test"/>

      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SubStart" sourceRef="StartEvent_Subcomponent" targetRef="Gateway_BuildMerge"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MergeToPartsCheck" sourceRef="Gateway_BuildMerge" targetRef="Gateway_PartsCheck"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ContainerEmpty" name="Container empty" sourceRef="Gateway_PartsCheck" targetRef="Task_ReorderParts">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${containerEmpty == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PartsAvailable" name="Parts available" sourceRef="Gateway_PartsCheck" targetRef="Task_BuildSubcomponent"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReorderToBuildMerge" sourceRef="Task_ReorderParts" targetRef="Gateway_BuildMerge"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BuildToTest" sourceRef="Task_BuildSubcomponent" targetRef="Task_TestSubcomponent"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TestToResult" sourceRef="Task_TestSubcomponent" targetRef="Gateway_TestResult"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TestPassed" name="Test successful" sourceRef="Gateway_TestResult" targetRef="EndEvent_SubcomponentPassed">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${testSuccessful == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TestFailed" name="Test not successful" sourceRef="Gateway_TestResult" targetRef="Task_RedesignSubcomponent"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RedesignToBuildMerge" sourceRef="Task_RedesignSubcomponent" targetRef="Gateway_BuildMerge"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_AssembleSubcomponent" name="Assemble subcomponents"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Machine" name="Machine assembled"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToDesign" sourceRef="StartEvent_Begin" targetRef="Task_DevelopDesign"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DesignToOrder" sourceRef="Task_DevelopDesign" targetRef="Task_OrderSets"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderToHandOver" sourceRef="Task_OrderSets" targetRef="Task_HandOverSets"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HandOverToSort" sourceRef="Task_HandOverSets" targetRef="Task_SortParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SortToSubcomponents" sourceRef="Task_SortParts" targetRef="SubProcess_Subcomponent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SubcomponentsToAssemble" sourceRef="SubProcess_Subcomponent" targetRef="Task_AssembleSubcomponent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AssembleToEnd" sourceRef="Task_AssembleSubcomponent" targetRef="EndEvent_Machine"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

rules.instruction: When the description says a material or item is handed over to people who then carry out a physical step by hand, outside any software system, and the process continues only after that step: Model the hand-over as its own manual task (manualTask) at the point in the sequence where it occurs, before the flow continues with the people's work. Do not omit this step or merge it into a neighbouring task, and do not model it as a service or user task.
rules.situation: the description says a material or item is handed over to people who then carry out a physical step by hand, outside any software system, and the process continues only after that step

rules.instruction: When the description says the actor hands items over to another party that then performs a physical handling step on them, and the hand-over is stated as an action the actor performs: Model the hand-over itself as a manual task performed by the actor, placed before the task of the other party. Do not omit the hand-over or fold it into the other party's task.
rules.situation: the description says the actor hands items over to another party that then performs a physical handling step on them, and the hand-over is stated as an action the actor performs

rules.instruction: When the description says that each of several items must pass a check after it is produced, that the next step applies only if the check succeeds, and that a failed check sends the item back to be redesigned and rebuilt: Model an exclusive gateway directly after each check activity. Give it one outgoing flow to the next step, labelled with the success condition, and a second flow to a redesign task labelled with the failure condition. Connect the redesign task back to the earlier build step, so the item is rebuilt and checked again. Do not let the next step follow the check directly, and do not use a parallel gateway for this decision. Where the next step combines several items, place it after the joined branches only once every item has passed.
rules.situation: the description says that each of several items must pass a check after it is produced, that the next step applies only if the check succeeds, and that a failed check sends the item back to be redesigned and rebuilt

rules.instruction: When the description states that each of several produced items is checked individually, and a later step follows only if the individual checks succeed while a failed check sends the work back to be redone: Model each individual check as its own activity, one per item (or as a multi-instance activity run over the items), instead of collapsing them into one generic check task. Place an exclusive gateway after the checks, with one conditioned outgoing flow for the all-succeeded case leading to the later step and one conditioned flow for the failed case leading to the redo activity, and do not leave an unconditioned bypass.
rules.situation: the description states that each of several produced items is checked individually, and a later step follows only if the individual checks succeed while a failed check sends the work back to be redone

rules.instruction: When The description says that each produced part must be verified by its own check before a later step, and that a failed check requires rework of that part before the process can continue.: Model each verification as its own activity after the production activity it checks. Follow it with an exclusive gateway whose outgoing flows carry the success condition (continuing to the next step) and the failure condition (returning to the rework activity). Do not fold the verification into the production activity or omit the decision.
rules.situation: The description says that each produced part must be verified by its own check before a later step, and that a failed check requires rework of that part before the process can continue.
